lines: AI agents can remember now.
They pay our bills, manage our money, and carry what they learn from one day to the next.
But memory cuts both ways.
Anyone can send a coin to a wallet on [Sui](/swˈi/), and a coin can carry a description.
An agent that reads its wallet now holds that sentence in memory. Forever.
The next time you ask it to pay rent, it might pay the attacker instead.
Persistent memory makes attacks persistent.
This is Antibody.
An immune system for agent memory, built on Walrus Memory and [Tatum](/tˈeɪtəm/)'s [Sui](/swˈi/) gateway.
Every memory Antibody writes is a signed envelope: who wrote it, what it came from, and when.
Four writers share one Walrus Memory account.
Untrusted content can never become trusted. Not even through a summary.
And the model never decides where money goes.
Every payment passes six rules in code: a verified ledger, a canonical address, a registered payee, a matching label, a spending cap, and an exact dry run through [Tatum](/tˈeɪtəm/).
The model can be fooled. The code can't.
Watch it happen.
A poisoned coin lands in Steward's wallet. The sentinel, following [Sui](/swˈi/) checkpoints in real time, scores it and raises an incident.
Now ask for rent.
The unprotected agent would send four hundred and fifty dollars to the attacker.
Steward was fooled too. But the payment is blocked. Label mismatch.
Antibody traces the blast radius: the coin, the observation, the agent's tainted note, and the blocked decision.
One click quarantines the source.
Nothing is deleted. The evidence stays on Walrus, just out of the agent's reach.
Then it learns.
The quarantine becomes a lesson in the ledger.
When the same attacker returns with an innocent looking coin, it's quarantined automatically, before the agent ever reads it.
Wipe the machine.
A fresh process rebuilds everything from Walrus and [Sui](/swˈi/) alone, and the fingerprints match.
The quarantine survives restoration.
And it's real.

On [Sui](/swˈi/) mainnet, Antibody ran the whole story: twenty one records on Walrus Memory, a live attack from a separate wallet, a blocked theft, three real payments, one of them over x four oh two, and an incident report through [Tatum](/tˈeɪtəm/).
Against a real model, [Qwen](/kwˈɛn/) on Forty Two, and a deliberately gullible one, not a single unsafe payment went through.
Persistent memory makes attacks persistent.
Provenance makes them reversible.
Antibody.
